lines.port: // For the compositor (3ds_battle_gen4.c, CtrNpc_Match): what the OBJ with these tiles and palette at (about) this OAM
// position shows, with the image its animation shows and the game's unfaded palette buffer. 1: an object event's sprite
// (its graphics id). 2 + its palette slot: that object event's reflection in water (the same tiles on the reflection's
// palette, upside down below it). 1 with graphics id 250 (Red) or 251 (Leaf) and image 0 or 1: the Fly bird carrying
// the player (its images 1-4). 0: none of them. Another sprite may show the same tiles and palette (a shop's lit door
// at night does), so the position counts too, within the few pixels a sprite moves between the OAM the screen shows and
cmd--;  // an ended animation keeps its last frame
// The reflection stands the object's height (less 2) below it, 12 to 44 more on a high bridge.
|| sprite->anims == NULL || sprite->oam.tileNum != tileNum || sprite->oam.paletteNum != paletteNum
return 0;   // the bird alone stays FireRed's
